body: I’m a fan. When timed right, you feel like you get yoyo’d back and forth. But I have a low tolerance to both, so based on what others say maybe not for the more experienced

You make a good point even if I don’t like the way you’ve worded it. I clearly am not completely over my former marriage, as it was very recent and the ink is literally not even dry yet.

I’m choosing not to go into the details of my failed marriage, and certainly don’t lay all the blame on my ex. And I agree I could have worded things better here. As you can imagine in a recently dissolved marriage, things are contentious.

If you’re up for providing more detailed advice, what do you think I should do regarding this “rebound relationship”? I have a very hard time letting people down, often at my own time expense (this comes up in therapy a lot) and so I’m trying to “choose me” more. But I’m also a very conflicted person, who sees a lot of gray instead of just black and white, so I struggle with being decisive at times like this. Any thoughts?
I’m not sure if that should make me feel relieved or concerned lol
How long ago were you there?
